name: hyperframes-video-build
description: HyperFrames video build. Pins are the newest mirror-approved versions (public npm is blocked; the corporate mirror 403s anything inside its ~14-day cooldown). Test a tarball's HTTP code before bumping either pin. gsap is a real dependency because every project vendors node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js into its own assets/ - a CDN reference renders a silently frozen video when the network is unavailable at render time.
